metrics_file.description: YAML file containing the metrics definition. Leave empty to use the package default.

addr.description: Address to bind and listen on. Empty string for all interfaces.

port.description: Port to bind and listen on

pidfile.description: Path to trafficserver PID file; used with procstats

no_ssl_verification.description: Disable SSL certificate verification on metric collection

max_retries.description: Maximum retries for DNS lookups or connection timeouts/failures

verbose.description: Verbose logging level (repeat for more verbosity)
